Vehicle was traveling north on N1 in heavy rain at approximately 80 km/h. Third party vehicle changed lanes suddenly from right to left without indicating. Our driver immediately applied brakes but due to wet road conditions, vehicle slid forward and made contact with rear bumper of third party vehicle. Impact was at low speed but caused damage to both vehicles.

Traffic officer on scene: Officer J. Mthembu, Badge #12345, Midrand Traffic Department. Passenger in third party vehicle: Sarah Nkosi, Contact: 083 444 5555
